name: Sardine, Lemon & Jalapeño Linguine
steps: If you’re making the breadcrumbs, put the slices of bread and ½ the jalepeno into a mini chopper and blitz into breadcrumbs. Add some olive oil to a pan over a medium high heat and then add the breadcrumbs. Cook for 2 - 3 mins or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown and crisp. Tip into a small bowl. Finely dice the remaining ½ jalapeno and add the breadcrumbs along with a big pinch of salt, set aside.

Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil. Thinly slice the lemon into rounds, removing any seeds. Drop the lemon slices into the boiling water and cook for a minute to soften and mellow. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same saucepan, add the spaghetti and cook following pack instructions until al dente. Meanwhile, finely slice the garlic and thinly slice 1/2 the jalapeño.

Place a large frying pan over a medium heat and add the butter. Let it melt and cook for 2-3 mins until it turns nutty and brown. Watch it closely so it doesn’t burn. Add the garlic and jalapeño, then cook for 1-2 mins until fragrant and softened.
Add the blanched lemon slices to the brown butter and let everything bubble together for 2-3 mins so the lemons soak up all that flavour and lightly caramelise at the edges.

Once the pasta is cooked, use tongs to slosh the pasta into the brown butter pan. Toss well until glossy and emulsified, adding a little more water if needed. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper.

Gently break the sardines into large pieces and add them to the pan. Carefully fold them through the pasta so they stay chunky and don’t completely disappear. Cook for 30 seconds just to warm through.
Divide between bowls and top generously with the crispy spicy breadcrumbs.
